remarks: Completely remodeled in 2021- and an additional lot included! Welcome to 9490 Erie Road, where updated living space meets the benefit of extra outdoor room. The detached garage provides parking and storage, while the additional lot is a standout feature included in the sale. a two-bedroom, one-bath ranch offering approximately 780 square feet. The eat-in kitchen features white cabinetry and recessed lighting, while wood-look vinyl plank flooring creates a cohesive feel throughout the interior. A separate living room, first-floor laundry, and central air round out the home’s practical layout. Step outside to enjoy the patio, with a detached garage providing parking and storage space. The sale includes an additional lot—a standout feature that adds outdoor space to this Evans property. Come explore everything this property has to offer!
